content: जि €1 <ab>P.</ab> (<ab>Ātm.</ab> when preceded, by परा and वि) (जयति, जिगाय, जिग्ये, अजैषीत्-अजेष्ट, जेतुम्, जित) .²1 To conquer, defeat, overcome, vanquish, subjugate; जयति तुलामधिरूढो भास्वानपि जलदपटलानि <ls>Pt. 1. 330</ls>; <ls>Bk. 15. 76</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">19. 2</ls>. .²2 To surpass, excel; गर्जितानन्तरां वृष्टिं सौभाग्येन जिगाय सा <ls>Ku. 2. 53</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 34</ls>; <ls>Ghaṭ. 22</ls>; <ls>Śi. 1. 19</ls>. .²3 To win (by conquest, in gambling or in a law-suit), acquire by conquest; प्रागजीयत घृणा ततो मही <ls>R. 11. 65</ls>; (where जि means ‘to conquer’ also); <ls>Ms. 7. 96</ls>. .²4 To curb, restrain, control, conquer (as passions). .²5 To be victorious, be supreme or pre-eminent (generally used in benedictory stanzas or salutations); जयतु जयतु महाराजः (in dramas); स जयति परिणद्धः शक्तिभिः शक्तिनाथः <ls>Māl. 5. 1</ls>; जितमुडुपतिना नमः सुरेभ्यः <ls>Ratn. 1. 5</ls>; <ls>Bh. 2. 24</ls>; <ls>Gīt. 1. 1</ls>. .²6 To convict. .²7 To overcome or get the better of (as a disease <ab>&c.</ab>). .²8 To expect from (with <ab>abl.</ab>). --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (जापयति) To cause to win or conquer. --{%<ab>Desid.</ab>%} (जिगीषति) To wish to win, acquire or excel, to vie with, emulate, to seek for; चलति नयान्न जिगीषतां हि चेतः <ls>Ki. 10. 29</ls>. With अधि to conquer defeat, vanquish; <ls>Bk. 19. 2</ls>.
